data.name: Huda
data.gender_notes: Huda is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ه-د-ي (h-d-y), 'to guide'. Hudā means 'guidance'. Its root is ه-د-ي (h-d-y). A central Qur'anic concept. Huda is a Arabic name meaning “Guidance; right path”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Huda expresses “Guidance; right path”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ه-د-ي (h-d-y), 'to guide'. Hudā means 'guidance'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Huda total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
